description: UNI-2567 items 7 and 8. Declares, per required CI check, which test suites constitute REQUIRED_EVIDENCE. A suite that exists but executed zero tests is not evidence, however green the job concluded. Consumed by scripts/ci-evidence-manifest.mjs.

classes.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Zero execution fails the completeness check. Use for security, tenant-isolation, auth, migration and release integration proofs.
classes.ALLOWED_NON_BLOCKING: Zero execution is recorded in the evidence record but does not fail the completeness check.

prerequisite.note: Absent in the repository secret store as at 16/08/2026, which is why every integration suite below self-skips. UNI-2567 item 5 (fail-closed preflight) and the SPINE_DATABASE_URL provisioning decision are both out of scope for this check and remain open.
